description: Free, no sign-in needed: check a Dutch e-invoice — SI-UBL 2.0 (NLCIUS, the Dutch government and SimplerInvoicing standard), NLCIUS CII or Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 from a Dutch supplier — against 30 SI-UBL 2.0 / NLCIUS rules (BR-NL-*), Peppol's 9 Netherlands rules (NL-R-*) and 103 EN 16931 rules. Returns pass/fail with rule IDs, line numbers and plain-language fixes; KvK/OIN, address, buyer-reference and payment-means problems are named explicitly. Not the official validator (no XML Schema check, not every EN 16931 rule); for a final check: https://test.peppolautoriteit.nl/validate. The invoice is not stored. Shares the 20 free calls per hour per connection with the other free tools (check_peppol_receivability, search_peppol_directory, check_factur_x and check_si_ubl).

filename.description: Original file name, shown in the report.

force_si_ubl.description: Apply the SI-UBL 2.0 rules even if the CustomizationID doesn't say SI-UBL 2.0 (default false: detect it).

xml.description: The complete invoice XML (UBL Invoice / CreditNote or CII).

name: check_si_ubl
title: Check a Dutch SI-UBL 2.0 / NLCIUS invoice (free)
